title: Bring your own validation check

scenes.heading: The recipe needs one more check
voice: Your application team depends on a storage class specific to its clusters.
Add a validation check for that requirement so its result appears alongside the checks AICR already runs.

scenes.heading: Package it and declare its contract
scenes.sub: Give AICR an image and a phase.
voice: Package the storage check as a container that follows AICR's exit-code contract.
Register the image, timeout, and phase in the validator catalog under your external data directory.

scenes.heading: An unknown check stops early
scenes.sub: The recipe and catalog names must match.
voice: Reference the check by its exact name in the recipe's deployment phase.
If there is a typo or a phase mismatch, AICR rejects the run before creating a validator Job.

scenes.heading: Correct the name and run again
scenes.sub: Read the custom and built-in results.
voice: With the name corrected, run validation using your recipe and external data.
The report shows the storage check with the built-in checks, so operators can see which requirement needs attention.
scenes.result: Storage check in the phase report

payoff: Register a containerized prerequisite check and catch a misspelled catalog name before any Job starts.
